# Loihi2_SpikeEncoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The specific spike-timing and amplitude encoding scheme used on Intel's Loihi 2 chip, optimized for sigma-delta converted signals. Determines the practical fidelity and energy efficiency of converted networks, critical for real-time edge applications.
